content: Listen to the night wind across the dunes; it carries the secrets of those who crossed before you.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: When the caravan settles at twilight, the endless chatter of commerce fades into the cool sands. In the immense stillness of the desert night, the soul remembers its eternal origin. Stillness is not emptiness; it is the presence of ancient truth.
practicalInsight: Step outside under the stars tonight. Listen in total stillness for two minutes without uttering a word.
reflectionPrompt: When was the last time you allowed complete, vast stillness to speak to your soul?
